top_signals.title: Wheat Extends July Rally as War Risks Stoke Fears Over Supply
top_signals.summary: Wheat climbed to a two-year high in Chicago and Paris, as escalating geopolitical tensions and worsening weather in key producing regions continued to stoke supply concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ‘Ridiculously Tight’ US Preferred Spreads Risk Trapping Buyers
top_signals.summary: US banks are raising regulatory capital at the tightest valuations since the financial crisis, unsettling the most seasoned investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
